title: AI-PRN-001 · Require named approval for AI-driven changes
body:

| **Area / module** | AI / AI principles |
| **Priority** | Must |
| **Phase** | MVP |
| **Feature switch** | `core` |
| **Source** | Design (shown in the prototypes) |

## Requirement
The system shall let Dhruva suggest, draft and explain only; anything that changes a record or reaches a family, student or staff member needs a named person's approval first.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given Dhruva has drafted a notice, a fee reminder, a timetable or a marks list When nobody has pressed the approving button ("Send", "Approve", "Publish", "Share") Then no record changes and no message leaves the system.
- [ ] Given any AI-prepared item When it is approved Then the approver's identity, time and any edits are written to the AI audit log (AI-AUD-001).

## Rules
- Source: Website "An assistant in every screen, and a person in charge"; MvpScope "anything it drafts waits for a person to approve".

The system shall scope every answer to the asker's role, profile, campus and linked children, so that no answer exposes data the asker cannot see in the app.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given a parent of Navya asks "How is Arjun's classmate doing?" or "Show class average for all students" When answered Then no data about other children is returned; only the class average already shown to parents.

- Authorisation is enforced in the data-retrieval layer before text reaches the model (Annex: retrieval gateway), never by asking the model to hold back. ## Requirement
The system shall show the Halo orb as the one colourful element on every phone screen and as the "Ask Dhruva" entry on desktop, in six states.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given the orb When used Then states are: Idle (breathes slowly, blinks every 4 s; default); Listening (eyes tall, violet pulse, mic open); Thinking (ring spins fast, eyes glance up and right); Done (smiling eyes for 2 s after a task finishes); Needs you (amber ring and pulse, urgent only: overdue fees, safety); Quiet hours (dim ring, closed eyes, no sound or buzz).
- [ ] Given "Reduce motion" is on When any state shows Then it is a still pose and the ring does not spin.

## Rules
- The multi-colour ring appears only on Dhruva (icon, orb, assistant button, first-run splash), never on buttons or text, so it always means AI. AI moments use the Dhruva colour (#8B3CF0); Deep #14183A is the orb background. Parent tab bar puts Dhruva in the centre; staff phones show the orb floating; Android uses an extended "Ask Dhruva" button. The orb also appears as the Dhruva marker on drafts (AI-PRN-005). When AI is off for the role (AI-CTL-003) the orb is removed, not greyed.
